cases.name: knowledge-write apply: an ADR citing no context id still sits in its context's delta, so its id is never given again
cases.cmd:
K={{KIT}}/scripts; R={{FIX}}/kw-adr-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; cp -R {{FIX}}/kw-base $R; cd $R || exit 1; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R
ST=$(python3 $K/knowledge-write.py init); mkdir -p $ST/Catalog/adr
printf '# ADR-?1 — Logs in UTC\nChoice: every timestamp in UTC.\n' > "$ST/Catalog/adr/ADR-?1-logs-in-utc.md"
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply --context Catalog | head -1 | cut -d'|' -f2; git add -A; git commit -qm adr
ST=$(python3 $K/knowledge-write.py init); mkdir -p $ST/Catalog/adr; : > $ST/Catalog/adr/ADR-001-logs-in-utc.md
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply --context Catalog | head -1 | cut -d'|' -f2; python3 $K/next-id.py ADR

cases.name: knowledge-write apply refuses a draft staged outside a context folder — nothing written
cases.cmd:
K={{KIT}}/scripts; R={{FIX}}/kw-loose-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; cp -R {{FIX}}/kw-base $R; cd $R || exit 1; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R
ST=$(python3 $K/knowledge-write.py init); mkdir -p $ST/adr; printf '# ADR-?1 — Loose\nChoice: x.\n' > "$ST/adr/ADR-?1-loose.md"
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply; echo "rc=$?"; echo "written=$(test -d docs/business/adr && echo yes || echo no)"

expect.stderr: refused: adr/ADR-?1-loose.md: staged outside a context folder

cases.name: knowledge-write apply: a rule left in a use case's file that two use cases apply is refused — its place is rules.md; a rule of rules.md one use case applies is only warned
cases.cmd:
K={{KIT}}/scripts; R={{FIX}}/kw-place-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; cp -R {{FIX}}/kw-base $R; cd $R || exit 1; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R
ST=$(python3 $K/knowledge-write.py init); mkdir -p $ST/Catalog/usecases
printf '# CAT-CU-?1 — Archive a product

## Rules

### CAT-RM-?1 — Partitioned to the organisation
Outcome: `ProductNotFoundException`

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `ArchiveProductCommandHandler`: load.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?1-archive-product.md"
printf '# CAT-CU-?2 — Consult products

## Rules

Also applies: CAT-RM-?1.

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `GetProductQueryHandler`: load.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?2-consult-products.md"
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
printf '# CAT-CU-?1 — Archive a product

## Handlers <!-- kit:handlers -->

- `ArchiveProductCommandHandler`: load.
' > "$ST/Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-?1-archive-product.md"
printf '# Catalog — cross-cutting rules

### CAT-RM-?1 — Partitioned to the organisation
Outcome: `ProductNotFoundException`
' > $ST/Catalog/rules.md
python3 $K/knowledge-write.py apply 2>&1 | grep '^WARN'

expect.stdout:
refused: CAT-RM-001 in Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-01-archive-product.md, applied by CAT-CU-01, CAT-CU-02 — belongs in Catalog/rules.md
nothing written
exit=1
WARN CAT-RM-001 in Catalog/rules.md, applied by CAT-CU-02 — belongs in Catalog/usecases/CAT-CU-02-consult-products.md
